Split-fleet series (qualifying / final)

Championship scoring where a large entry races in qualifying fleets, then splits into Gold/Silver/Bronze for a final series on one continuous points line — the RRS Appendix LE Addendum C format. Each example is drawn from a real ILCA/Optimist/… championship (see its provenance line) and shows the combined, fleet-tinted standings a scorer would publish; medal-race points are doubled and shown in bold. See docs/design/split-fleets/format-survey.md.

Examples

#Scenario
1 F1 continuous carry: fleets seeded by ranking, qualifying scores carry into the final total, Gold outranks Silver
2 F1 IODA: exactly one discard, unlocked at 5 races — there is never a second
3 F2 medal race: doubled non-discardable medal points; companion 'last race' scored from below the medal fleet
4 D1 no split: too few races to divide the fleet — the qualifying ranking is the official result
5 D3 finale scheduled but never sailed: the companion 'last race' does not run, and the opening series stands
6 D5 unequal final counts: Gold sails more final races than Silver — both score correctly
7 D6 qualifying closed early: abandoned days force the split at the minimum race count
8 D8 equalisation: a qualifying race one fleet never sailed does not count for anyone
9 D10 redress across the split: RRS A9(a) average points (fractional) and promotion into a higher fleet
10 Reassignment: seed by ranking, then reshuffle the fleets by standings after each day
11 Penalties on finishers (SCP/DPI): tenth-of-a-point rounding, the DNF cap, and a medal-race code scored at the base, not doubled
12 Frozen rounds: a protest decided after the next round is drawn re-scores the standings but never re-deals the fleets
13 F5 net+net carry: the qualifying and final series are scored separately and added, so each discards its own worst race
14 F6 carried-position carry: the qualifying finishing position becomes one non-excludable score and the qualifying race scores drop out
15 F3 compressed carry: the medal boats' opening-series score is halved before the medal races add to it, and the compression changes the winner
16 F3 tie-break: the halved carry leaves two boats level, RRS A8 cannot separate them, and the final-series ranking decides the championship
